paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
notes: Model-independent radio search using Breakthrough Listen/GBT data over 1020-2700 MHz. Limits are reported on the DM decay rate (lambda ~ 1e-32 s^-1) and annihilation cross section (<sigma v> ~ 1e-30 cm^3/s) vs frequency/mass, NOT on a particle coupling constant like g_agamma. None of the enumerated coupling types (which expect a coupling vs mass) apply directly, so coupling_type is set to null and no data points are extracted. Local DM density assumed rho_NFW(rs)=0.471 GeV/cm^3 (Burkert 0.487). Decay photon energy assumed h*nu = m_chi c^2/2. 3-sigma exclusion criterion used. The pre-analysis hint of AxionPhoton is overridden because the exclusion plots use decay rate / cross section on the y-axis.
